persona: Mid-level SAP HCM and India payroll consultant
resumeText:
Sneha Iyer | Chennai | sneha.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
SAP HCM Consultant, Marina Enterprise Systems, Chennai (2019 - present)
- Configured personnel actions, custom infotypes and org structure in SAP HCM for a 12,000-employee manufacturer.
- Maintained work schedules, absence quotas and time evaluation schemas for three plants.
- Changed India payroll schemas and PCRs for the new wage code and tested results in parallel runs.
- Updated PF, ESI and professional tax settings and checked monthly statutory reports.
- Ran parallel payroll runs and user acceptance testing for the H4S4 move with the HR team.
- Resolved payroll and time tickets in ServiceNow within the agreed SLA each payroll cycle.
- Gathered requirements from HR and wrote functional specifications for custom payroll reports.

SAP HR Support Analyst, Coromandel Infotech, Chennai (2017 - 2019)
- Handled infotype data corrections and employee master uploads using LSMW.

SKILLS
SAP HCM, SAP Payroll, ABAP debugging, Excel

EDUCATION
MBA Human Resources, Madras University, 2017
